description: Translate one block of text into a target language using Cloudflare Workers AI. Input is text plus target_lang, with an optional source_lang. The answer carries the model name, the requested language and the raw model output, and is flagged machine_generated rather than verified. Output is not deterministic: repeat calls can word the same text differently. Use it for quick drafts of UI strings, emails and short docs. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, no account, no API key). 【価格】0.00 USDC。【使い方】呼ぶと 402 と PAYMENT-REQUIRED（支払い条件）が返る。USDC で支払い、同じ引数に PAYMENT-SIGNATURE ヘッダを添えて再送すると結果が返る。
name: translate
